evidence: We increasingly utilize artificial intelligence ( AI ) and machine learning technologies across various aspects of our manufacturing operations, including quality assurance, predictive maintenance, production automation, and supply chain planning.

The Company's productivity improvement target, measured as labor minutes per unit, is to achieve at least 8% savings per year. This is an increase from previous target of 5% savings per year. The increase reflects mainly increased opportunities related to advances in digitalization and automation, including machine learning and AI.
Strategic Initiatives, including Automation, Digitalization, Machine Learning and AI, Supply Chain Management Effectiveness and RD&E Effectiveness.
ai_positioning.summary: La société Autoliv utilise l'IA en interne pour améliorer ses opérations de fabrication et atteindre ses objectifs de productivité. Elle intègre l'IA dans ses processus de qualité, de maintenance prédictive, d'automatisation de la production et de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
